note: Calle Guillermo runs down beside the big-pool lawn to the paseo instead of stopping on top of a 3 m bank. Turned-frame metres (sea downward). Heights are metres above street level; the lane's surface heights live on the roads in data/street_layout.json (0.27 is street level there, as for every road), the outlines in data/main_pool.json (levels.lowerArea, surfaceRing, sheetCut). scripts/build_lowered_lanes.py derived both from this file once.
trust: From Apple Maps 3D screenshots (Dave, 2026-10-21): the lane falls continuously from beside the steps to Enrique's down to the paseo, the white wall between it and the lawn gets lower towards the sea, Calle Jorge joins part-way down with no steps seen, and the kiosk at the foot stands at lawn level. Apple's mesh shows which way the ground falls, not heights. Estimated: the slope starts at the foot of the Enrique's steps (turned z 80.7) and falls evenly to paseo level (-3 m, Dave's pool level) at the lane's end, about 7.6 %; Jorge's last stretch ramps at 9 % to meet it, about 1.8 m below street level at the junction (no photo shows Jorge); the 0.5 m parapet on the lawn side is a guess. Houses stay at street level; the gardens beside the lanes do too, except the garden behind the east end of the paseo wall (gardenFall).

gardenFall.evidence: Dave, 2026-10-21, on a render of the corner by the foot of Calle Guillermo: the sandstone wall there is not 3 m tall. IMG_2227 (issue #40) suggests about 1 m and shows the sandstone band ending at a planted slope; apple-maps/11 shows the gardens beside the lower lane falling towards the sea.
gardenFall.trust: The 1 m wall is from Dave's correction and IMG_2227, not measured. The garden's shape is the open ground between the wall face (carried on to the lane), the house fronts, Calle Guillermo and turned x -110 (where the paseo is back to 1 m below street level); it falls evenly from street level at the houses to 1 m above the paseo at the wall. Houses stay at street level.
